collection.description: A villager finds a little fish they carved into a tree as a child, now at about the height of their waist.

setup.name: The moment
setup.text: Walking through the grove, (name1) stops at a tree and finds, carved into the bark, a wobbly little fish and a mark that is unmistakably (his/her) own. (He/She) carved it as a child, standing on tiptoe, reaching as high as (he/she) possibly could. It's still there. It's still exactly where (he/she) put it. It is now at about the height of (his/her) waist. For a moment (name1) is confused, as though the tree has shrunk. Then (he/she) understands: the tree didn't move the carving down. (He/She) grew up past it. (name1) crouches to look at the little fish properly, eye to eye, the way (he/she) did all those years ago. It's a terrible fish. (He/She) loves it.
